events.description: A violent physical altercation erupts within a dense crowd in a street corner; multiple individuals are seen grappling, pushing, and striking each other, with visible motion blur indicating rapid movement and impact.

The localized fighting escalates into broader group violence: the crowd disperses chaotically down a narrow street, with individuals running, shoving, and engaging in coordinated aggressive movements, consistent with riotous behavior.

In a different location (a wider street with debris), two men engage in a clear mutual physical fight: one lunges while the other blocks or counters, both in dynamic combat stances; others observe or retreat, confirming active combat rather than post-conflict activity.

events.description: A large group of men in a narrow street are engaged in chaotic, violent movement: pushing, shoving, and some appear to be throwing objects or swinging arms; the density and motion suggest collective violent unrest rather than isolated scuffles.

In a more open street area, two individuals are clearly engaged in mutual physical combat: one is lunging while the other braces and appears to strike back; others nearby observe or move away, indicating a focused fight within a broader disturbance.

A crowd gathers in an alley/street junction; individuals are animated, some raising arms, turning abruptly, and moving with urgency; debris is visible on ground (see later frames), consistent with ongoing unrest and object-throwing.

Close-up of scattered rocks and debris on pavement, including irregularly shaped stones of varying sizes—consistent with projectiles used in a riot. The presence and distribution strongly indicate recent or ongoing stone-throwing as part of collective violence.
A person is on the ground surrounded by others who appear to be striking or kicking them; the victim is crouched or prone and unable to defend themselves.
Police in riot gear (helmets, shields) advance in formation through a street while civilians scatter; context suggests violent unrest with active confrontation.
After the assault, people disperse rapidly down the street; police are no longer visible in frame, but the chaotic dispersal and debris suggest ongoing unrest following violent clash.
A chaotic street scene with multiple individuals running, throwing objects, and engaging in violent group unrest; debris is scattered on the road, and people are seen falling or being struck.

A person is seen on the ground while another individual appears to strike or kick them; this occurs near the 'A CARLIN' storefront and is visible across consecutive frames showing the victim prone and the assailant leaning over.

A large crowd converges on a burning vehicle (or debris) in the street; many individuals are raising arms, holding sticks or planks, and surrounding the fire—indicating collective violent unrest rather than passive observation.

A large crowd of civilians confronts riot police and an armored vehicle in an urban street; smoke and fire are present, and the armored vehicle deploys a water cannon, indicating violent unrest and group clashes.
A sudden burst of flame and dense smoke erupts from a vehicle or object near the armored vehicle, consistent with an explosion (e.g., Molotov cocktail impact), visible across frames f1–f3.

A bright linear flash emanates from the side of the armored vehicle (likely a weapon discharge), visible as a distinct streak in frames f8–f12; however, due to black-and-white footage and motion blur, it could alternatively be a water jet reflection—confidence is moderate.

A large crowd of civilians is engaged in violent unrest in a street, surrounding and confronting an armored military vehicle (Ferret scout car). People are seen throwing objects, surging toward the vehicle, and engaging in chaotic group clashes; debris is scattered, and the atmosphere is highly agitated.
Close-up frames show multiple individuals in physical combat: punching, grappling, and shoving within the dense crowd near storefronts, indicating mutual physical violence among participants.

A sudden burst of smoke/dust and visible disruption occurs around the armored vehicle at 119.5s, with frame f7 showing a cloud of debris and obscured view consistent with a nearby blast or impact (e.g., petrol bomb or grenade), though no fireball is visible.

A crowd of civilians, including children, is actively throwing objects (e.g., debris, possibly stones) at an armored vehicle in a damaged urban street; the vehicle appears to be maneuvering or retreating amid debris and smoke.
A bright flash illuminates the interior of a building through multiple windows in frame f15, consistent with a sudden internal explosion or detonation; smoke is visible above the structure.
